record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare SPARKLING_ARIA in this production reference (maxPP 80, range 3; Popplio and Brionne have passive HATCH, Primarina none). The strategy is shared; the HATCH passive was not analysed here.
record.summary: Area burst around the cast target. The cast target takes SPECIAL damage of 15/25/50 raw by the caster's stars (Popplio 15, Brionne 25, Primarina 50); every unit of another team standing in one of the 8 cells around the target takes the same raw amount. Every adjacent unit on the caster's own team that is burning has its burn healed and gains burn immunity (IMMUNITY_BURN) for 3000 ms; allies that are not burning are not touched. The adjacent cells are read before the primary hit and the damage is not reduced for the surrounding units.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target) as the centre; affected: enemy-team units in its 8 neighbouring cells; own-team burning units in those cells
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the cast target is chosen before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: target cell plus the 8 surrounding cells (3x3 block, diagonals included)
geometry.note: the neighbour list excludes the centre and off-board cells; the primary target is hit separately by its own call

effects.scaling: every hit: AP x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by each victim's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crits (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT). The same crit flag is used for every victim.
effects.resolution: requested amount per victim = the raw value (no falloff) -> AP/crit -> PokemonState.handleDamage (defenses, SPE_DEF division with minimum 1, shield; core-mechanics §A/§H); applied HP loss and takenDamage (shield part included) differ per victim. protect / skydiving / magicBounce victims take no damage (magicBounce reflects damage to the caster). The ability reads no takenDamage.

statusEffects.target: adjacent own-team units whose status.burn is true at cast time (the caster included if it stands next to the target, which a range 3 caster normally does not)
statusEffects.applicationOrder: inside the same adjacent-cell loop as the damage, per unit in board scan order; healBurn first, then the immunity effect is added and a 3000 ms delayed removal is pushed on that unit
statusEffects.guards: only for units with status.burn; healBurn returns immediately when no burn. While IMMUNITY_BURN is present, triggerBurn does not apply a new burn. The delayed command deletes IMMUNITY_BURN from the unit's effects after 3000 ms regardless of where the effect was added; IMMUNITY_BURN is also added in passives.ts and pokemon-entity.ts (not traced), and a second cast adds another delayed removal.
statusEffects.combatEffect: healBurn clears the burn flag and origin, sets burnDamageCooldown to 1000 and reverts the Guts, Well Baked and Magmarizer stat changes that triggerBurn applied.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value 100 (also the fallback) is not reachable by the three units' star counts (1, 2, 3). maxPP is 80 and range 3 for all.

record.positionalConditions: The affected set is whatever stands in the 8 cells around the cast target at the moment of the cast; the cell list is built before the primary hit.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast re-evaluates the neighbours; each burning ally cured gets its own 3000 ms immunity removal command.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 15/25/50 by stars (15 Popplio, 25 Brionne, 50 Primarina), the same requested amount for the target and each adjacent enemy. Applied: raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then SPE_DEF division and the other handleDamage steps, separately per victim; takenDamage includes shield damage. Burn cleanse: flag cleared, immunity 3000 ms.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); handleDamage was consulted via core-mechanics §A/§H, not re-probed here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
